description: Asks the slides agent to build or change a report, or to answer a question about it, as the app's chat does. Answers the message's id at once: follow it with getReportMessage. Without chatId the message starts a new chat, which shows in the user's chat history in the app. With it, the message continues that chat and waits its turn while a reply is still generating. Several chats on a report can generate at once; an agent working on a part of the report another chat is editing works on something else or says so. For slides built from your own data, a connected dashboard, a warehouse table or a spreadsheet, upload the data with createDataset, find the dashboard or Salesforce report with searchDashboards, the Snowflake or Databricks table with searchTables or the spreadsheet with searchSpreadsheets, add any of them with addReportDatasheets and pass the datasheet ids as datasheetIds. For a brief, a report or notes to build from, upload it with createDocument and pass its id in documentIds. Only its editors may. At most 6 messages a minute per user. To write the slides yourself instead, start with getReportDesign.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

answers.description: Your answers to the questions of a `clarification` reply, as when you pick options in the chat in the app: one entry per question you answer. Send them as the next message on the same chat, by passing its `chatId`. When a picked option offers a dashboard, table or spreadsheet, Rollstack adds it to the report as a datasheet before the agent goes on. To add a note, send it in `content` with the answers.
The `label` of each option picked: one for a question whose `multiSelect` is `false`, one or more when it's `true`.

header.description: The `header` of the question you're answering, copied unchanged from the `clarification` reply's `questions`.

question.description: The question you're answering, copied unchanged from the `clarification` reply's `questions`. With `header`, it tells Rollstack which question your picks are for.
examples: Which chart should show revenue by region?

chatId.description: The chat to continue: the `chatId` returned for an earlier message. The agent reads the chat's earlier messages as context, and if it's still replying in that chat, your message waits its turn (`queued`). If omitted, the message starts a new chat, which shows in your chat history on the report in the app. Must be one of your own chats on this report.

content.description: Your message to the slides agent, as you would write it in the chat in the app: for example, slides to build or change, or a question about the report. On a report with no slides yet, the agent takes it as a request to build the report. A link to a picture in the message, such as a logo or a photo to place, is downloaded and given to the agent. Required unless you send `answers`; with them, it's sent after your answers as a note. At most 10,000 characters: send a longer text, such as a brief, as a document with `createDocument`.
examples: Add a slide comparing revenue by region

datasheetIds.description: Datasheets of this report for the agent to work from, on top of those on the slides in `slideIds`, as when you pick data in the chat in the app. To have the agent build slides from data you just added, pass the ids `addReportDatasheets` returned; for data already on the report, take them from `listReportDatasheets`. 1 to 100 datasheets of this report.

documentIds.description: Documents for the agent to read, as when you attach documents in the chat in the app: the ids `createDocument` returned. The agent reads their text and looks at their pages, for example to build slides from a brief or to rebuild a report as slides. 1 to 5 documents your organization can read.

slideIds.description: The slides your message is about, as when you select slides in the app before writing in the chat. The agent knows you selected them and uses the datasheets on them for your request. Slide ids come from `getReportContent`. 1 to 100 slides of this report.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: sendReportMessage
title: Send message to slides agent
